listing.name: Guitar Hero II (plus classic Harmonix song imports) — Guitar Hero Classic (noahbaxter)
listing.original_game_title: Guitar Hero II (plus classic Harmonix song imports)
listing.summary: This release uses a disc-folder setup and remains in development. GHClassic is not confirmed to be the same project as Recomp-Hero-2; use the instructions for this implementation. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PlayStation 2 Guitar Hero II SLUS-21447 ISO. Other original Guitar Hero discs are optional imports.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the portable Windows or Linux runtime folder, or the macOS disk image. Place your own USA SLUS21447 disc in PUT_DISC_HERE. Follow GHClassic’s instructions; the archived ghpc prototype points to this replacement project.

warnings: This release uses a disc-folder setup and remains in development. GHClassic is not confirmed to be the same project as Recomp-Hero-2; use the instructions for this implementation.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
